Simulate a pedigree

Source: R/sim_ped.R
sim_ped.Rd

Simulates a pedigree with overlapping generations, some inbreeding, and some unknown parents. Individuals are numbered in birth order, so that parents always come before their offspring, and each individual picks its parents among the window individuals born just before it. It is meant for testing and benchmarking.

Usage

sim_ped(
  n = 1000,
  n_founders = 40,
  window = 150,
  p_unknown = 0.05,
  numeric_ids = FALSE
)

Arguments

n

Total number of individuals (larger than n_founders).

n_founders

Number of individuals with no parents at the start.

window

Number of preceding individuals among which parents are drawn.

p_unknown

Probability that a parent (mother or father separately) is unknown for a non-founder.

numeric_ids

If TRUE, individuals are identified by the integers 1 to n (in birth order) and unknown parents by 0, as many programs of animal breeding expect (e.g. ggroups::buildA()). If FALSE (the default), identifiers are character strings and unknown parents are NA.

Value

A data frame with columns id, dadid, momid and sex (1 = male, 2 = female). Identifiers are character strings such as "ind0001", with NA for unknown parents, or with numeric_ids = TRUE integers, with 0 for unknown parents.

Both forms can be given as they are to fastrel_ped(), fastrel_vec() and rel_add(), which all take 0 as an unknown parent.

Details

The result depends on the state of the random number generator of the session: call set.seed() beforehand to make it reproducible.

Examples

set.seed(1)
ped <- sim_ped(200)
head(ped)
#>        id dadid momid sex
#> 1 ind0001  <NA>  <NA>   1
#> 2 ind0002  <NA>  <NA>   2
#> 3 ind0003  <NA>  <NA>   1
#> 4 ind0004  <NA>  <NA>   1
#> 5 ind0005  <NA>  <NA>   2
#> 6 ind0006  <NA>  <NA>   1
A <- fastrel_ped(ped)
range(diag(A) - 1)
#> [1] 0.00 0.25

## the same pedigree with integer identifiers and 0 for unknown parents
set.seed(1)
ped_num <- sim_ped(200, numeric_ids = TRUE)
head(ped_num)
#>   id dadid momid sex
#> 1  1     0     0   1
#> 2  2     0     0   2
#> 3  3     0     0   1
#> 4  4     0     0   1
#> 5  5     0     0   2
#> 6  6     0     0   1
all.equal(unname(fastrel_ped(ped_num)), unname(A))
#> [1] TRUE

## ready for other packages, e.g. ggroups (columns: individual, sire, dam)
if (requireNamespace("ggroups", quietly = TRUE)) {
  all.equal(unname(ggroups::buildA(ped_num[, c("id", "dadid", "momid")])),
            unname(A))
}
#> [1] TRUE
